Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Hamlin Capital Management Lifted At&T (T) Stake; At&T (T) Share Value Declined While Rnc Capital Management Trimmed by $1.89 Million Its Holding 
April 9, 2018 - By Louis Casey 
Hamlin Capital Management Llc increased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 7.43% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hamlin Capital Management Llc bought 214,566 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 3.10M shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $120.58M, up from 2.89 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hamlin Capital Management Llc who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $228.21 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.01% or $0.005 during the last trading session, reaching $35.135. About 1.10 million shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since April 9, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500. 
Rnc Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 4.43% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rnc Capital Management Llc sold 49,660 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.07M shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $41.66M, down from 1.12M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rnc Capital Management Llc who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $228.21 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.01% or $0.005 during the last trading session, reaching $35.135. About 1.10 million shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since April 9, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500. 
Analysts await AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) to report earnings on April, 24. They expect $0.87 EPS, up 17.57% or $0.13 from last year’s $0.74 per share. T’s profit will be $5.65 billion for 10.10 P/E if the $0.87 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.78 actual EPS reported by AT&T Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 11.54% EPS growth. 
Rnc Capital Management Llc, which manages about $4.08B and $1.44 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Lilly Eli& Company (NYSE:LLY) by 4,832 shares to 465,435 shares, valued at $39.31M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1,972 shares in the quarter, for a total of 95,269 shares, and has risen its stake in Suntrust Banks Inc (NYSE:STI). 
Investors sentiment decreased to 0.91 in Q4 2017. Its down 0.26, from 1.17 in 2017Q3. It is negative, as 67 investors sold T shares while 714 reduced holdings. 125 funds opened positions while 589 raised stakes. 3.09 billion shares or 7.58% less from 3.34 billion shares in 2017Q3 were reported. Gp One Trading LP reported 260,820 shares stake. Brookstone owns 231,612 shares for 0.81% of their portfolio. Ontario Teachers Pension Plan Board accumulated 547,868 shares. Hanson And Doremus Mngmt reported 60,656 shares. First United Retail Bank Trust invested in 0.45% or 17,575 shares. Wealthtrust Fairport Ltd Liability Com holds 0.05% or 13,295 shares. Capital Advsr Ok owns 55,114 shares. Rathbone Brothers Public Ltd Company owns 102,088 shares for 0.16% of their portfolio. 106,441 were reported by Dowling & Yahnke Lc. Mairs Pwr Inc has invested 0.02% in AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T). Farmers Tru Com owns 84,382 shares or 0.97% of their US portfolio. Laffer reported 0.15% of its portfolio in AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T). Hap Trading Ltd Com invested in 1.04M shares. Haverford reported 175,073 shares. Agf Invests America accumulated 33,573 shares. 
Among 31 analysts covering AT&T Inc. ( NYSE:T ), 12 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 39% are positive. AT&T Inc. had 77 analyst reports since July 27, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Tuesday, April 5 by Macquarie Research. The stock of AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) earned “Perform” rating by Oppenheimer on Tuesday, November 8. Oppenheimer maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Tuesday, July 25 report. On Tuesday, July 18 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Buy”. The rating was maintained by Argus Research with “Buy” on Tuesday, April 11. The stock of AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) earned “Hold” rating by KeyBanc Capital Markets on Wednesday, October 11. The stock has “Buy” rating by HSBC on Wednesday, March 28. On Tuesday, July 18 the stock rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Hold”. On Thursday, February 1 the stock rating was maintained by SunTrust with “Hold”. The stock of AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) earned “Sector Weight” rating by KeyBanc Capital Markets on Tuesday, January 2. 
Hamlin Capital Management Llc, which manages about $2.70 billion and $2.60 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Abbvie Inc (NYSE:ABBV) by 25,904 shares to 776,311 shares, valued at $75.08 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Abb Ltd (NYSE:ABB) by 61,428 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 2.49 million shares, and cut its stake in Westrock Co.   Louis Casey
